about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB with native FP8 Engram rows cached in 64 GiB DDR5 + local NVMe O_DIRECT and DSpark block 5 (524,288 context, 4.2M KV tokens)
setup: Requires four 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, 128 GB DDR5 host RAM (64 GiB bounded Engram row cache), and ~510 GB on a local NVMe SSD supporting O_DIRECT. Runs SGLang TP4/EP4 with DSpark block 5, 524,288-token context, and 4,200,000 allocated KV tokens (4,063,744 populated KV tokens verified across 8 simultaneous 500k requests). Reproduce with `docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.measured.yaml up --build -d`.
